title: Generate mean profiles with a target pairwise cosine — generate_mean_signature_matrix
text: Builds \(\boldsymbol{\mu}\\mathcal{M}_{G\times J}\) blending shared unit direction \(\boldsymbol{u}\) cell-type-private orthogonal marker directions \(\boldsymbol{v}_{j}\): $$   \tilde{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_{\cdot j}   =   \sqrt{\rho}\,\boldsymbol{u}   +\sqrt{1-\rho}\,\boldsymbol{v}_{j},   \qquad   \boldsymbol{\mu}_{\cdot j}   =   s\,   \frac{\tilde{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_{\cdot j}}{     \|\tilde{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_{\cdot j}\|_2   }. $$ \(\rho\[0,1]\) target_cosine \(s>0\) mean_scale (default 10, matching nine-scenario simulation grid). private vectors \(\boldsymbol{v}_{j}\) indicator directions partition \(G\) genes (type \(j\) ) \(\ell_2\)-normalised, \(\boldsymbol{v}_{j}^{\mathsf{T}}\boldsymbol{v}_{k}=0\) \(j\neq k\). shared unit \(\boldsymbol{u}\), $$   \tilde{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_{\cdot j}^{\mathsf{T}}   \tilde{\boldsymbol{\mu}}_{\cdot k}   =   \rho   +   \sqrt{\rho(1-\rho)}\,   \bigl(     \boldsymbol{u}^{\mathsf{T}}\boldsymbol{v}_{j}     +     \boldsymbol{u}^{\mathsf{T}}\boldsymbol{v}_{k}   \bigr)   \qquad (j\neq k). $$ column normalisation pairwise cosines \(\boldsymbol{\mu}\) therefore track \(\rho\) closely cross terms \(\boldsymbol{u}^{\mathsf{T}}\boldsymbol{v}_{j}\) small relative leading \(\rho\) (many genes per block). global scale \(s\) sets column norms (hence Euclidean separation) without changing angles: fixed \(\rho\), \(\|\boldsymbol{\mu}_{\cdot j}-\boldsymbol{\mu}_{\cdot k}\|_2 \propto s\). Prefer dialling \(\rho\) second-order precision weights already control interaction strength; keep \(s\) fixed across scenarios compare mean collinearity alone (Aliee Theis 2021) .
